meta.title: Add field support to DynamicDataAttribute
meta.body_summary: Add support for public static fields as data sources in DynamicDataAttribute to improve test data management performance by avoiding repeated object creation from property getters or methods.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added field support to DynamicDataAttribute with analyzer/source gen; one reviewer requested removal of a backup file; merged without performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Although total line count is large due to merge commits bringing main changes and localization files, the core feature change is modest (~850 lines across feature commits). The PR was merged after trivial cleanup review.

review_details.concern_detail: Evangelink requested removal of global.json.bak that was committed by the agent.
review_details.performance_claim: Static fields avoid repeated object creation compared to property getters/methods.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding field detection to a test framework attribute across multiple layers (attribute, analyzer, source gen) is within agent capability when the change is additive and well-defined.

detection_detail.code_reading: Evangelink noticed the accidental backup file in the diff and requested its removal.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or before/after performance data; only narrative claim in PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Backup file removed via Copilot commit 576bf64.

core_change_summary.description: Extended DynamicDataSourceType enum with Field=3, added field detection in DynamicDataOperations, updated DynamicDataAttribute to use field, updated analyzer DynamicDataShouldBeValidAnalyzer to accept fields, updated source generation model, added unit and integration tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Large line counts mainly from localization xlf updates and merge commits bringing main branch changes.
